text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after my first<n>three years with
Shinko Windy have<n>passed...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: LACKEEEY! Big news! Ya gotta hear<n>this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I got the scoop of the century!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The whole menu at the cafeteria is<n>ninety-nine
percent off right now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, really! The carrot hamburger<n>steak lunch is
dirt-cheap! Same for<n>the pudding and cake!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But only the first ten customers get<n>the discount.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We gotta get there, fast! Drop<n>everything and follow
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's about lunch time anyway, so I<n>follow her to the
cafeteria, but when I<n>ask the staff about the
discount...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's news to me...<n>ninety-nine percent off?
You have to<n>be joking, right? Haha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pwfff... Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wooohooo! I gotcha good!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Too bad for yoooou! You'll just have<n>to pay the
regular price!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe! And since I'm already here, I<n>guess I'll
grab a bite too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heck, I'll even keep ya company. I<n>wanna see your
disappointed face as<n>I enjoy my meal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has a big ole smirk on<n>her face.
Wait... this must mean...
choice_data_list: Did you want to have lunch with me?
Did you want to have lunch with me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha talkin' about?! Do you even<n>hear
yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I wanted to see your dismayed<n>reaction, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to talk with her<n>about upcoming
races, so this is a<n>perfect opportunity. I mention this
to<n>her, and that big smirk comes back to<n>her face.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh? You don't say. The diabolical<n>strategist's
back at work.
choice_data_list: Let's work hard for the next race.
Let's work hard for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Obviously!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've still gotta spread my "bad name"<n>throughout
the racing world! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So chop, chop! Hurry up and get<n>some food—we've
got a scheme to<n>hatch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us enjoy our meal<n>while having
a productive<n>conversation about racing and<n>training.
